title: Failed tests and tampered artifacts remain visible
expected: A failed test still produces an accurate failed bundle with available reports.
Changing a finalized output fails digest validation; interrupted finalization is incomplete, not success.

cases.name: controlled-test-failure
cases.change: Set EXAMPLE_FAIL=1 for the test action.
cases.expect: Nonzero exit and failed tests in the bundle.

cases.name: tamper
cases.change: Append bytes to a finalized artifact.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
